meta.name: geniml
meta.description: Use Geniml for audited local genomic-interval workflows: validate BED and universe contracts, plan Region2Vec or scEmbed runs, inspect model/tokenizer compatibility, and assess consensus universes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证并规划本地基因组间隔工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果处理基因组数据并需要验证BED文件
copy.tagline_en: Validate and plan local genomic-interval workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with genomic data and need to validate BED files

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会基于 geniml 帮你处理基因组区间(BED)数据的机器学习任务:校验 BED 与 universe、规划 Region2Vec 或 scEmbed 运行、检查模型/分词器兼容性、评估共识峰区。
howto.when: 当你处理 BED 文件做机器学习,如训练区域嵌入(Region2Vec)、分析 scATAC-seq 或构建 consensus universe 时。

say.text: 我要分析一批 BED 文件,该用 Region2Vec 还是 BEDspace?
say.note: Claude 会根据你的数据情况推荐工具。

say.text: 帮我规划用 scEmbed 分析 scATAC-seq 数据的步骤
say.note: 会给出预处理、训练、聚类的完整流程。

say.text: 检查我的 universe 文件质量
say.note: 会评估共识峰区并给出改进建议。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude guides you through Geniml workflows for BED-based genomic ML: validating BED files and universe contracts, planning Region2Vec/scEmbed runs, checking model compatibility, and assessing consensus universes.
howto.when_en: When you work with genomic interval data (BED files) for ML tasks, such as training region embeddings, single-cell ATAC-seq analysis, or building consensus peaks.

say_en.text: I have BED files to analyze; should I use Region2Vec or BEDspace?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest based on your data.

say_en.text: Plan a scEmbed run on my scATAC-seq data.
say_en.note: Gives preprocessing, training, and clustering steps.

say_en.text: Check the quality of my universe file.
say_en.note: Evaluates consensus peaks and suggests improvements.
